verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/search endpoint accepts nprobe=0, nprobe=-1, and nprobe=1000 without validation. Source code confirms generateSearchParams() in utils.go performs NO validation, simply passes through fmt.Sprintf('%v', value). Physical constraint from IVF documentation: nprobe must be 1~nlist (number of cluster units). Accepting nprobe=0 (selects 0 cells, meaningless) or nprobe=-1 (negative) violates basic IVF index semantics. This is a true parameter validation gap in REST v2 API, consistent with blindspot pattern 'REST v2 data type handling'.
